title: Vapouriz 50/50 Rainbow Fruits 10ml
description: Rainbow Fruits is a sweet, candy-inspired flavour that delivers a medley of juicy fruit notes wrapped in a tangy sherbet sparkle. Hints of citrus, berry, and orchard fruit come together in a nostalgic blend reminiscent of chewy sweets with a zesty sherbet twist. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is suitable for both new and experienced vapers looking for a well-rounded vape with vibrant flavour and smooth throat hit. It works best in MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits and vape pens. Produced in the UK by Vapouriz Labs, the Vapouriz 50/50 range brings together consistent quality and accessible flavour variety, designed to suit a wide range of vape styles and devices. The 50/50 ratio offers an ideal middle ground between flavour intensity and vapour production, making it a go-to choice for users of starter vape kits, pod devices and other low-power e-cigarette setups.
